preconditions: Owned temporary model/profile files and Work roots; real native model, graph, SRX, checkpoint and transaction paths. In-process tests use an explicitly labelled recorded-build fixture; process tests build and run the actual module/zipapp. Trusted host registry, initial binding and normative publication authority are explicit test harness inputs.
steps: Build the actual core module tree and zipapp and invoke their trusted host evaluation adapter in independent isolated Python processes with no PATH discovery.
Move runtime, Work and protected project roots between invocations, remove original captured source files and alternate resource profiles; resume from durable bytes.
Verify exact final native results and reject an incompatible build before a writing lease.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Release-Abnahme MUSS die in Kapitel 14.7 definierten Prozess-, Pfad-, Sandbox- und Cachewechsel ohne notwendige Sessions nachweisen.
oracle.scope: Actual built module and zipapp executions continue in fresh processes after inode-preserving path changes and original source loss, without an in-memory prior session. Missing/empty/corrupt caches and incompatible builds are checked. This is current-host evidence, not the entire release portability matrix. Closed trusted host API for finite explicitly saved model/profile inputs and complete native evaluation units. Whole evaluations and the input set are currently memory-resident; general CLI/Code-8 integration, evaluation Work-package export/restore, bounded within-evaluation durable cursors, later commands and full platform/sandbox/release coverage remain open. Rename cases preserve inode identities and use identical built bytes. Hash consistency does not authenticate foreign Work data; results do not claim current project-file verification.
